patterns.note: Full-width sections with content centered horizontally, often featuring a large, bold heading followed by a descriptive paragraph and sometimes a grid of examples or a large visual.
A dominant dark mode aesthetic with a black background and white text, punctuated by vibrant, diverse colors within showcased project grids and UI elements.

Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport. The initial hero content scrolls away, and a dynamic grid of site previews moves up to fill the primary visual space, revealing more items as the user scrolls down.
Extensive use of large, interactive-looking UI elements or video embeds (e.g., a design studio interface, a dashboard) as primary visual content within feature sections.
A prominent, dynamic grid layout is used to showcase numerous site examples and resources, often appearing as a central visual element after the hero section.

technique_notes: The site uses a dark theme with high contrast white text. Interactive elements like buttons and links use a subtle accent color. Large, full-bleed sections are used to create visual separation.

Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal new content sections. As the user scrolls, elements like headings, paragraphs, and visual components (e.g., large UI screenshots, cards in a grid) fade in or slide up from the bottom of the viewport. The initial hero content scrolls out of view, and a dynamic grid of examples moves into the primary visual area, expanding to show more items.
The navigation bar starts transparent and fixed at the top, then becomes sticky with a solid dark background after the initial scroll past the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold display headings (~4-5x body) with clear, legible body text and smaller, uppercase labels for secondary information.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card-like elements, maintaining a modern, clean aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of spaciousness and clarity.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated use of a dynamic, expanding grid of diverse project examples that takes over the hero space after initial scroll, combined with large, interactive-looking UI embeds that effectively demonstrate product capabilities within a dark, minimal aesthetic. This creates a highly engaging and visually rich experience without feeling cluttered.
